about.title: Who we are
about.lead: Urban Fight Academy is a martial arts gym in Bucharest built around real training — from your first class to competition level.
about.body: For adults we offer Boxing, MMA, BJJ and Kickboxing, with beginners, advanced and pro groups. For kids — BJJ, Kickboxing, Judo and Karate. Individual training sessions are available. We welcome collaboration and are ready to open new groups. The first group session is free; we’ll refine the details with the club’s final info.
